slides.en: I listen to books on Amazon's Audible.
slides.tip: Use で to indicate the means or method.

grammar.title: Using で for Means or Method
bullets: Use で to indicate the means or method by which an action is performed.
Audible's new feature is a hot topic in Tokyo's tech-savvy circles, highlighting the city's embrace of AI innovations.
Locals often discuss new tech features using simple verbs like 使います (to use).
